newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - New issues Telegroup, Goshen eke up.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - New issues Telegroup, Goshen eke up.

text.p: Shares of Telegroup Inc, GSB Financial Corp and Horizon Pharmacies Inc all moved higher on their first day of trading Wednesday after initial public offerings.
-- Telegroup shares rose 1-1/2 to 11-1/2 after its IPO, but only after lead underwriter Smith Barney sharply pared back terms of the IPO to sell four million shares at $10 each.
The Fairfield, Iowa, company provides international telecommunications services. It previously planned to sell 7.2 million shares at $14-$16.

-- GSB Financial Corp shares jumped 4-5/8 to 14-5/8 after it converted from a mutual to a stock form of ownership. It offered 2,248,250 shares for $10 each. GSB is the holding company for Goshen Savings Bank of Goshen, New York.
-- Horizon Pharmacies shares rose 9/16 to 5-9/16 after its IPO on the American Stock Exchange.
